Job Description

The Team

We are seeking a Project Manager to join American Tower’s Information Security Team. The Information Security Team is responsible for cybersecurity operations, risk management and governance of cybersecurity programs and controls across American Tower. Day to day you will plan, coordinate, and deliver Information Security initiatives while providing Program Management Office (PMO) support. You will be responsible for maintaining project plans and reporting on the overall Information Security project portfolio, which includes Identity and Access Management; tool implementations (SIEM, DLP, CASB, EDR); cloud security initiatives; vulnerability management, network, and firewall management; and others. In addition, you will track and report on IT and business-owned projects that have Information Security interests. You will also be responsible for PMO responsibilities related to resourcing, budgeting, prioritization and escalations; as well as participation in governance meetings and the generation of reporting and metrics for executive leadership and stakeholder audiences. As a Project Manager, you will work cross-functionally with Information Technology, Business Enablement and other business to drive the execution of Information Security projects and controls.

Responsibilities

What You Can Offer Us

Lead and manage Information Security projects throughout the project lifecycle, from initiation through closure including developing and maintaining project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
Monitor project scope, risks, issues, budget, and resource utilization as well as facilitate project governance meetings, steering committees, and status reviews.
Ensure project deliverables align with organizational security objectives and strategic priorities.
Coordinate project activities across cybersecurity, infrastructure, applications, cloud, networking, and business teams.
Facilitate communication and issue resolution among project teams and executives.
Coordinate dependencies across multiple projects and programs.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment on project objectives and priorities. Identify, document, and track project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies. Proactively escalate critical risks and obstacles to leadership as necessary, developing mitigation and remediation plans to address project challenges.
Maintain project portfolio dashboards, reporting metrics, and executive status updates for Information Security projects and IT and Business-owned projects that have Information Security interests.
Manage project intake, prioritization, scheduling, and portfolio governance processes.
Manage information security policy and standard maintenance activities.
Coordinate resource allocation across multiple Information Security and IT initiatives including the monitoring of resource utilization and capacity to identify conflicts, constraints, and optimization opportunities. Collaborate with managers to secure appropriate staffing and project support.
Coordinate the creation, tracking, and management of purchase orders (POs) and vendor-related expenditures working with Finance, Procurement, and IT leadership to ensure timely processing of POs and invoices.
Track software licensing, maintenance renewals, consulting services, and project-related expenditures.
Serve as a liaison between Information Security, IT Operations, IT Application Development, Procurement, Legal, and Business Enablement Teams.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent work experience) in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Project Management, and/or related field is required.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Agile certifications preferred.
8+ years of project management experience supporting Information Technology and/or Information Security initiatives required.
Experience with PMO governance, portfolio management, and resource planning tools such as Monday.com, Microsoft Project, Jira, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 required.
Experience managing projects with significant cross-functional collaboration from IT Infrastructure, IT Operations and Application Development teams required.
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or PCI DSS required.
Familiarity with IT Infrastructure and Computer Networking concepts required.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a complex global enterprise environment required.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid approaches required.
Experience with PMO activities related to resource and capacity management, budget management, procurement processes, and purchase order administration required.
Experience with change management and software development lifecycle requirements required.
Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the established timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.

American Tower is a global digital infrastructure company serving customers through tower sites and other real estate solutions that support connectivity and opportunity, focused on achieving our vision of Building a More Connected World. About the job
The role

You own one client program end to end: their CMS website platform and the organic pipeline it produces.
Two teams sit under that outcome. Engineers own the CMS stack, performance, integrations and releases. The SEO and marketing team owns discoverability, site structure and conversion. Organic leads only move when both are working, so one person owns both rather than two people negotiating across a boundary. That person is you.
You'll run it inside an AI-charged delivery process. AI drafts requirements, stories, test cases and much of the code; our people approve every stage before work moves on. On our last core platform programme, 81% of delivery work products were AI-drafted before review, and it shipped in four months against the client's own twelve-month estimate. Both are our own measurement.
One consequence: your specification isn't a handoff document, it's an input an AI system executes against. Ambiguity a human engineer would quietly resolve becomes a defect at volume. Writing precisely is the core skill, not a soft one.
What you'll do

Carry the program number. Delivery and lead growth are one accountability, not two
Work directly with client senior stakeholders: CMO, CIO, VP Engineering, Head of Growth
Run the CMS roadmap with a technical product owner and engineers: architecture tradeoffs, page performance, integrations, release decisions
Set SEO priorities against the same funnel and sequence them alongside engineering work, not behind it
Write requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough to execute against without guesswork
Review AI-generated artifacts and decide what passes and what goes back
Report what moved the number, what didn't, and what changes next
Hold scope and quality when a client asks for more, faster, and both. Flag slippage early, not at the deadline

What we're looking for

5+ years running technical programs, product ownership or delivery-side program management on software that reached production
You've owned an outcome, not a backlog. Bonus if it spanned engineering and growth
Working command of modern CMS and web stacks, headless or traditional, and what actually makes a site fast
SEO understood as an engineering problem: crawl, index, structure, page experience. You don't need to have run keyword research. You do need to know why a rendering decision costs rankings
Exceptional written English. It's the most heavily tested skill in our process
Fluent in enterprise reality: multiple stakeholders, legacy systems, change control, security review
Credible on architecture, data models and engineering tradeoffs without needing to code
Direct experience with US clients and comfort with US-hours overlap

Why it's worth your time

The founders are in the delivery, not just the sales call. The work is enterprise-scale: governed data platforms, production ML, AI agents at the point of work. Running AI-assisted delivery at this scale isn't yet a commodity skill. Neurogent is part of the NVIDIA Inception programme.

Job Summary

KBR is seeking a self-motivated Plans and Operations Analyst with Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in developing strategies, plans, and operations. Analyst must have an advanced understanding of Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS) and specifically an advanced understanding as it relates to Directed Energy (DE) C-UAS system employment in the National Airspace System in order to support the Department of War’s Joint Interagency Task Force 401 (JIATF 401). Analyst will support the organization’s Director, Executive Director, Division Chief, and other leaders as a focal point for the Department to synchronize and integrate C-UAS and DE efforts for all stakeholders (Office Secretary of War, Joint Staff, Services, and Interagency) CONUS and OCONUS activities with the goal of providing C-UAS capabilities to protect our Warfighters at home and abroad.

Roles And Responsibilities

Serves as a subject matter expert (SME) to the Integrated Portfolio Division leadership on matters related to Directed Energy C-UAS system employment in the National Airspace System.
Possess knowledge of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA)-managed National Airspace System (NAS) and its integrated network of U.S. airspace, including domestic and oceanic regions, navigation facilities, airports, rules, procedures, and personnel that ensure safe and efficient aircraft operations.
Provide technical expertise in the areas of Direct Energy (DE) and High Power Microwave (HPM) systems, integration, and operational concepts.
Stay current with emerging trends, regulatory requirements, and advancements in DE/HPM technologies to inform strategic planning, decision-making, and employment considerations.
Advise on threat analysis, system vulnerabilities, and countermeasure development related to DE/HPM capabilities.
Leads and/or participates in a variety of Directed Energy community of interest and DoW C-sUAS sub-working groups that actively develop joint solutions that resolve high-visibility problems related to C-sUAS mission accomplishment.

Provide summary/EXSUM of Shift Change key points to the Senior IMCC Operations and Intelligence Support / Senior Intelligence and Operations Analyst/Site Lead and the COR.
Monitor news media outlets for situational awareness, specifically for worldwide news reports that may impact INSCOM and Army equities. Maintain continuous surveillance of the world situation for items of interest to the INSCOM or ARSTAFF and report using the appropriate means (e.g. EXSUM, log entry, email, etc.) IAW established SOPs and Battle Drills.
Monitor NIPRNET, SIPRNET, and JWICS networks for worldwide and national events, both natural and manmade, that have an impact on the INSCOM organization or INSCOM operations. This includes, but is not limited to, earthquakes, hurricanes, bombings, active shooters, and military attacks. Initiate coordination with appropriate staff directorate and draft an INSCOM response IAW established SOPs and Battle Drills.
Monitor, track, and disseminate Theater Significant Activities (SIGACTS), SIPR, NIPR, and the Automated Message Handling System (AMHS) for Serious Incident Reports (SIR), OPREP-3s, and other messages that meet HQDA Senior Leader Critical Command Information Requirement (CCIR) criteria or may impact INSCOM elements. Take appropriate actions IAW IMCC/IMCC SOP or Battle Drills.
Monitor message traffic across NIPRNET, SIPRNET, and JWICS networks for immediate notification requirements for the INSCOM G-3 to satisfy requests for information (RFI) from CCMD intelligence elements, MSCs, the Army Cyber Command, and the AOC.
Receive, summarize, disseminate, track, and archive all INSCOM Serious Incident Reports (SIRs), outages and all Shift activities IAW IMCC SOP or IMCC Knowledge Enterprise protocols.
Disseminate, track, and archive all published HQDA Execution Orders (EXORD), Fragmentary Orders (FRAGOS), and Warning Orders (WARNOS) IAW IMCC SOP or IMCC Knowledge Enterprise procedures.
Receive orders for publication from G-33 Orders Production Cell or other Government personnel designated in writing by the COR to the contractor and disseminate orders in accordance with established INSCOM IMCC SOP.
Forward all HQDA Operations Briefs and selected JS Briefs via NIPR, SIPR or JWICS networks with the appropriate classification and caveats, by using the assigned distribution list. Compile and disseminate the CG and Senior staff daily-read books.

Update and maintain the current list of CCIRs from the CCDRs.
Synchronize IMCC operations and intelligence reporting in support of current, emergency, and crisis events.
Conduct analysis of operational requirements stemming from messages, plans, and orders issued by the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), HQDA, or Commanding General, INSCOM. Provide draft recommendations or response to the COR, or other Government personnel designated in writing by the COR to the contractor.
Maintain and update the INSCOM Common Operation Picture (COP), to include information pertaining to INSCOM's global deployments, disposition of forces and capabilities, INSCOM's support to global operations (steady state and contingency), global hotspots, and named and emerging areas of interest.
Prepare and conduct daily executive level Battle Update Briefs, generally at 0800 Fort Belvoir, VA local time; unless an alternate time is arranged. new_jobs.description:
Operations analyst, product marketing

Location:
Remote, Pacific and Mountain time zones preferred. Hybrid or in-office in Palo Alto, CA also available.

About the role:

Intapp is looking for an Operations analyst to bring analytical rigor to how we measure, optimize, and scale the impact of our go-to-market programs. You'll support the PMM team by tracking and reporting on the metrics that matter — content adoption, pipeline influence, seller engagement, and play utilization — and turning that data into clear, actionable insights that help the team make better decisions about where to invest and what to improve.

This is an analytical and operational support role. You'll build and maintain the reporting infrastructure that gives the PMM team visibility into what's working, contribute to the weekly and quarterly cadences that keep the team aligned and accountable, and dig into field, pipeline, and adoption data to surface insights that inform where the team focuses next.

What you will do:

RTB operational cadence and reporting

Support the rhythm that keeps the PMM org aligned and accountable. You'll build and maintain dashboards that track the KPIs that matter — content output velocity, field adoption rates, pipeline influence, seller readiness scores, and asset utilization — and keep them current, accurate, and easy for stakeholders to act on.

On a weekly cadence, you'll track performance across the function, flag anomalies and blockers early, and prepare stakeholder updates that surface the signal without burying people in data. You'll conduct ad hoc analysis when the numbers raise questions, digging into trends to understand what's driving them and what the team should do about it. Over time, you'll develop a strong point of view on where PMM is creating outsized impact and where the evidence points to gaps.

Sales play program analytics

Own the measurement and reporting layer for Intapp's sales play portfolio, giving the program team the data it needs to make good decisions about what to build, update, and retire. You'll track play utilization, seller engagement, pipeline influence, and win-rate differentials between reps who use plays and those who don't, and build the reports and visualizations that make those findings accessible to

PMM and sales leadership.

You'll contribute to the structured feedback loop by synthesizing field input, call intelligence data, and deal outcomes into clear summaries of what's resonating and what needs to change. You are a core analytical partner to the program owner, not a co-owner of the portfolio itself.

What you will bring:

Strong hands-on data analysis skills: you track engagement and pipeline data, build reports and dashboards, interpret feedback, and make recommendations based on evidence

Strong Excel skills for data analysis; SQL experience a plus

Hands-on experience with data visualization and business intelligence platforms; Tableau experience preferred, or willingness to learn

Genuine curiosity about what the data is actually saying — you don't stop at the number, you ask why

2–3 years of experience in sales operations, analytics, business operations, or GTM strategy in a B2B SaaS environment

Clear, direct communication: you write well and know how to make a complex data finding land simply for a non-technical audience

High attention to detail and comfort managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously

Bachelor's degree required; MBA optional

What you’ll gain at Intapp: 

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities.  We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork. 

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career. 

Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day. 

Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family.  Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.  

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

At Everforth ECS Federal, we believe technology should serve those who have served us. Partnering with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, we safeguard critical systems and sensitive data that directly impact the lives of millions of veterans and their families.

As a Senior Cyber Security Analyst, you will bring your expertise in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) to design strategies, assessments and tests to ensure sensitive veteran data remains secure, compliant, and resilient against evolving cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Incident Response Efforts - Coordinate and execute containment, eradication, and recovery activities during security incidents, ensuring minimal operational disruption.
Security Architecture Reviews - Evaluate and enhance system designs, network configurations, and application deployments to align with Zero Trust principles and DLP best practices.
Automation & Scripting for Security Operations - Develop and maintain automated workflows to streamline log analysis, alert triage, and compliance reporting.
Continuous Monitoring & Improvement - Implement advanced monitoring techniques to detect insider threats, anomalous behaviors, and policy violations in real time.
Audit & Compliance Readiness - Prepare systems and documentation for internal and external audits, ensuring adherence to NIST, FedRAMP, and VA-specific frameworks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner with DevOps, cloud engineering, and network teams to embed security controls early in the system development lifecycle.
Policy & Standards Development - Contribute to the creation and refinement of enterprise security policies, technical standards, and operational procedures.

Must be a U.S. citizen eligible to obtain and maintain a Tier 5 (critical sensitive national security) background investigation.

Monitor and analyze security events across VA systems, identifying anomalies and potential breaches in real time.

Conduct vulnerability assessments and recommend remediation strategies.

Develop and enforce security policies and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), cloud security, virtualization, and zero-trust network access.

Previous use of tools such as Elastic, Splunk, Wireshark, Kali Linux, Invicti, or other vendor-specific security platforms to monitor, analyze and secure digital environments.
Comfortable in explaining complex security issues, identifying root causes, and developing effective solutions to mitigate threats

new_jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About The Role

Clipboard is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst
to help build and run the systems behind our sales organization.

You'll work across Salesforce, data, automation, and internal tools to help our sales team operate more effectively. That might mean building an automation that eliminates a recurring workflow, investigating a messy data problem, redesigning part of our Salesforce setup, or building a new system from the ground up.

We are a small team with an unusual operating model. Much of our execution runs through AI agents that we direct and quality-check, allowing each analyst to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

This is equal parts builder and operator. You'll own systems end to end, work through ambiguous requests from reps and leadership, and be accountable for making sure the things you build actually work.

What You'll Do

Own live systems. Take ownership of production systems such as account distribution, deal intelligence, competitor tracking, and data sync pipelines. You'll be accountable for their accuracy and reliability.
Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.
Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.
Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.
Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.
Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.

What We're Looking For

Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.
AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.
High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.
Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.
Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.

SQL and Python experience are strong pluses, but we're more interested in your curiosity, judgment, and ability to ship than checking every technical box.

Nice to Have

Salesforce administration or development experience, including flows, SOQL, or data model design.
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, analytics, or a similar environment.
Experience building automations with tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents.

Interview Process

Application Review – We'll review your experience and evidence of things you've built, automated, or owned.
Take-Home Assessment – A practical, ~2-hour assessment using a fictional company, mock website, and CRM. You'll have 48 hours to complete it, and AI tools are encouraged.
Technical Walkthrough – A 45-minute session where you'll demo what you built, explain your decisions, and make a small live change to your system.
Manager Interview – A 30-minute conversation focused on communication, ownership, judgment, and how you operate under ambiguity.
Final Steps / Offer! – Some candidates may have an executive conversation, followed by references and an offer.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary
Insurance benefits + 401k options
Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays
Remote-first working environment

To get a better understanding of the general type of people we want to hire, you can check out our blog here.

Quick Note On Scammers

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation Range: $75K - $110K

The analyst ensures accuracy in data and assists in maintaining smooth functioning of investment operations. This role is ideal for individuals beginning their career in the investment operations industry.

Success in this role requires working well in a team environment, strong partnership with senior operations analysts and the curiosity to learn and apply core foundational investment operations concepts in executing routine tasks and analytics with accuracy.

Thrivent's Investment Operations function performs middle office work including analytics to execute the trade, reporting, process infrastructure and post-trade execution support. This team is a critical link enabling the front office to focus on investment strategies and client relations and provides the back office with accurate data for reconciliation and accounting.

Investment Operations & Trade Support

Liaise with external partners including brokers, custodians, and vendors to maintain strong working relationships and resolve issues.

Process Improvement

Support system enhancements, automation efforts, and cross-functional projects to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

Reporting & Compliance Support

Assist in preparing documentation for audits and internal reviews.
Ensure adherence to internal controls, compliance policies, and investment guidelines.

Leadership Competencies

Model Thrivent’s leadership competencies – Model the Way, Rally the Team, and Deliver Outcomes.
Support and/or develop an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. Shape and/or support a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients.

Job Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related area.
General knowledge of investment operations analyst work.
Ability and eagerness to work collaboratively in a team environment.
High level of intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset to learn and gain investment industry knowledge.

Catalina Marketing France SAS; company affiliated with Catalina Marketing Corporation (*)

Pourquoi Catalina? Chez Catalina, nous comprenons que notre succès résulte du talent et de l'engagement de nos collaborateurs. Nos principes directeurs ouvrent la voie à la victoire sur les marchés que nous servons, et notre potentiel est puissant. En rejoignant l'équipe de Catalina, vous ferez partie d'un environnement inclusif qui favorise la flexibilité, l'engagement communautaire, l'équilibre vie professionnelle et personnelle ainsi que des opportunités de croissance professionnelle.

Ton rôle

Au sein de notre pôle Analytics, composé de 28 experts, tu rejoindras une équipe de 14 personnes dédiée à l’accompagnement des enseignes de la grande distribution en France, en Italie et au Royaume-Uni.

En tant que Data Analyst Senior en CDI, tu mettras ton expertise au service de problématiques marketing concrètes. Ton objectif : transformer des données complexes en analyses pertinentes, puis en recommandations claires et directement activables par nos équipes et nos clients.

Tes Missions Et Responsabilités :

Extraire, cibler, analyser et interpréter les résultats de campagnes de marketing direct.
Identifier des leviers d’optimisation et formuler des recommandations stratégiques à destination de nos clients.
Accompagner les équipes commerciales dans la compréhension des enjeux et des problématiques clients.
Présenter tes analyses et échanger directement avec les clients en apportant ton expertise Analytics.
Concevoir et réaliser des études statistiques : segmentations, scoring, algorithmes de machine learning et projets liés à l’IA.
Développer des solutions d’automatisation avec Python et des outils d’ordonnancement.
Créer des tableaux de bord clairs et performants, notamment avec Power BI.
Participer à des sessions de brainstorming avec les équipes Data Science et Analytics afin de faire évoluer nos méthodes et nos indicateurs.
Contribuer activement à la veille méthodologique et au partage des bonnes pratiques au sein du pôle.

Le profil que nous recherchons

De formation supérieure en statistiques, tu possèdes une expérience validée en tant que data analyst de 3 ans idéalement dans le domaine du marketing. Tu es à l’aise avec les bases de données à forte volumétrie et tu sais mener un projet analytique de bout en bout, de la compréhension du besoin jusqu’à la restitution des résultats.

Tu as une excellente maîtrise du langage SQL (Jointure, Agrégation, Condition, Modification...)
Tu as une parfaite connaissance de Python, l’utilisation dans un environnement Cloud est un plus (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) 
Tu maîtrises la programmation orientée objet
Tu maitrises les techniques statistiques appliquées au Marketing Direct : échantillonnage, mise en place de témoins, analyse des résultats, bonne connaissance des techniques de segmentations et de scoring.
La connaissance des outils de Data visualisation comme Power BI est un plus 
Tu as déjà réalisé des projets de ML & AI.
Tu es capable de vulgariser votre discours auprès de vos interlocuteurs (équipe commerciale, équipe marketing, clients…) 
Le poste est sur un périmètre Français, avec des interlocuteurs français.
Tu te débrouilles en anglais car Catalina Marketing reste une entreprise internationale

Notre processus de recrutement

Un premier échange avec l’équipe Recrutement.
Un test technique en ligne d’une heure.
Un entretien avec Kim, Responsable de compte Analytics.
Un entretien avec Johan, Head of Analytics Retail.

Lieu : Boulogne-Billancourt, à proximité du métro Marcel Sembat.
Contrat : CDI.

Avantages : carte restaurant Swile, prise en charge des deux tiers de la mutuelle, avantages CSE et journée d’engagement associatif.
Vie d’équipe : team buildings, moments conviviaux, paniers de fruits et café à volonté.

Envie de transformer la donnée en décisions utiles pour de grandes enseignes françaises ? Rejoins-nous et échangeons sur ton prochain défi.

Catalina est un leader reconnu dans la connaissance shopper et les médias numériques et en magasin ciblés avec précision qui personnalisent le parcours des shoppers. Alimentée par une base de données shoppers en temps réel inégalée et une science des données optimisée par l'IA, Catalina aide les retailers, les marques de CPG et les agences à optimiser chaque étape de la planification, de l'exécution et de la mesure des médias pour obtenir des résultats pour nos clients. By joining the Catalina team, you will become part of an inclusive environment that promotes flexibility, community involvement, work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth.

Your role

Within our Analytics division, comprising 28 experts, you will join a 14-person team dedicated to supporting leading grocery retailers in France, Italy, and the United Kingdom.

As a permanent Senior Data Analyst, you will apply your expertise to real-world marketing challenges. Your goal: to transform complex data into relevant insights, and then into clear, actionable recommendations for our teams and clients.

Your Missions And Responsibilities:

Extract, target, analyze, and interpret the results of direct marketing campaigns.
Identify optimization opportunities and develop strategic recommendations for our clients.
Help Sales teams understand client challenges and business needs.
Present your analyses and engage directly with clients, providing your Analytics expertise.
Design and conduct statistical studies, including segmentation, scoring, machine-learning algorithms, and AI-related projects.
Develop automation solutions using Python and scheduling tools.
Create clear, high-performing dashboards, particularly with Power BI.
Participate in brainstorming sessions with the Data Science and Analytics teams to enhance our methods and KPIs.
Actively contribute to methodological research and the sharing of best practices within the division.

The profile we are looking for

You hold an advanced degree in Statistics and have at least three years of proven experience as a Data Analyst, ideally in marketing. You are comfortable working with high-volume databases and can manage an analytics project from end to end, from understanding the initial business need through to presenting the results.

You have excellent SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, conditions, and data modifications.
You have excellent Python skills; experience using Python in a cloud environment is a plus (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.).
You are proficient in object-oriented programming.
You have a strong command of statistical techniques applied to direct marketing, including sampling, control-group design, results analysis, segmentation, and scoring.
Familiarity with data-visualization tools such as Power BI is a plus.
You have already completed machine-learning and AI projects.
You can explain complex topics in clear, accessible language to a variety of stakeholders, including Sales teams, Marketing teams, and clients.
The role focuses on the French market and involves working with French-speaking stakeholders.
You can communicate in English, as Catalina Marketing is an international company.

Our recruitment process

An initial conversation with the Recruitment team.
A one-hour online technical assessment.
An interview with Kim, Analytics Account Manager.
An interview with Johan, Head of Retail Analytics.

Practical information

Location: Boulogne-Billancourt, near Marcel Sembat metro station.
Contract: Permanent contract.
Start date: As soon as possible, depending on your availability.
Remote working: Up to three days per week once your probationary period has been successfully completed.
Additional time off: One RTT day per month.
Benefits: Swile meal card, two-thirds of supplementary health-insurance costs covered by the company, employee social and cultural benefits, and one community-service day.
Team life: Team-building events, social gatherings, fruit baskets, and unlimited coffee

Ready to turn data into meaningful decisions for leading French retailers? Join us and let’s discuss your next challenge.

to support application development and support activities under CLIN 0004, translating ABMC stakeholder requirements into structured sprint deliverables for Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Power Platform, and related business applications. This role owns requirements documentation, functional design, backlog management, and user acceptance testing coordination across sprint cycles, working directly with ABMC's program and technical staff to ensure each iteration is authorized, documented, and delivered within Change Control Board (CCB) requirements. Demonstrated ability to produce government-deliverable documentation, including Requirements Summaries, Functional Designs, Test Plans, and Release Notes.
Experience working in sprint-based delivery models (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent) with formal backlog management and iteration planning.
Proficiency with Azure DevOps or equivalent backlog and project tracking tools. ^
Experience coordinating user acceptance testing with non-technical government stakeholders, including defect documentation and resolution tracking.
Strong knowledge of federal IT documentation standards and change control processes.
